title: End-to-end mTLS psql round-trip via the HAProxy HA pair VIP
description: Connects from outside-PG (the leader's nexusadmin shell) to PostgreSQL via the VRRP-floated VIP 192.168.70.60:5432 with sslmode=verify-full + sslrootcert pointing at the patroni-server CA bundle. Verifies the TLS handshake walks back to the lab root + the PG server reports the connection as SSL-on. Connecting via the VIP (not haproxy-pg-1 or haproxy-pg-2 directly) proves the cert IP-SAN design works -- both haproxy nodes' leaf certs carry the VIP so verify-full passes regardless of which haproxy currently holds it.

prerequisites.smokeGate: smoke-0.G.4.ps1 ALL GREEN; VIP 192.168.70.60 bound on exactly 1 haproxy node; pg_stat_ssl populated

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.61 'sudo test -s /etc/nexus-patroni/postgres-superuser-password && sudo test -s /etc/ssl/certs/patroni-ca.pem && echo PREFLIGHT_OK'

observe.what: KV-rendered postgres-superuser-password + operator-readable patroni-ca.pem both present on pg-primary

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.61 'SUPER_PWD=$(sudo cat /etc/nexus-patroni/postgres-superuser-password); PGPASSWORD="$SUPER_PWD" psql "host=192.168.70.60 port=5432 dbname=postgres user=nexusops sslmode=verify-full sslrootcert=/etc/ssl/certs/patroni-ca.pem" -tA -c "SELECT version(), current_setting(\"ssl\");"'

observe.what: Row with PostgreSQL 17.x banner + ssl=on; if the TLS chain fails the psql would error 'certificate verify failed'

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.61 'sudo -u postgres psql -h /var/run/nexus-patroni -U postgres -d postgres -tA -c "SELECT ssl, version, client_addr FROM pg_stat_ssl JOIN pg_stat_activity USING (pid) WHERE usename=\"nexusops\" ORDER BY backend_start DESC LIMIT 1;"'

observe.what: ssl=t (true), TLS version (1.2 or 1.3), client_addr = haproxy-pg backplane IP since HAProxy proxies the TCP stream
PG accepts the new connection over SSL; Patroni log shows no DCS state change

whatProves: End-to-end mTLS path through the HAProxy HA pair via VIP: psql client validates the server cert chain against the patroni-server CA bundle (the lab root); the cert's IP-SAN includes the VIP .60 so sslmode=verify-full against the floating IP passes regardless of which haproxy currently holds it; HAProxy proxies the TCP stream transparently (no SSL termination on the LB); PG's pg_stat_ssl confirms the live connection is encrypted with TLS 1.2 or 1.3. The same Vault PKI 90-day leaf TTL covers all 8 patroni-tier nodes uniformly.
